alcoholic_beverage_abv_from.reading: A beverage with a stated alcohol strength of 0.5 % vol or more is an alcoholic beverage; below that it is not. A class decided by strength (low-alcohol beer, malt beverage) stays UNKNOWN until the strength is stated.

label_alcohol_strength_above.reading: The actual alcoholic strength is a mandatory label particular for beverages above 1.2 % vol.
